faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about our products and solutions.

items.question: What is the difference between the IG 150 and IG 300-D1?
items.answer: IG 150 is designed as under-canopy support for lower-zone coverage, while IG 300-D1 is built for primary top-light coverage and simplified room layouts.

items.question: Can I use InnovoGrow lights in humid environments?
items.answer: Yes. Our commercial fixtures are designed for demanding cultivation spaces and built with durability in mind.

items.question: How do I choose the right light for my crop?
items.answer: We recommend starting with your facility type, canopy density, target output, and workflow. Our team can help map the right solution.

items.question: What mounting options are available?
items.answer: Mounting depends on the product family and application, from overhead suspended layouts to rack and under-canopy installations.

items.question: What is the warranty on InnovoGrow lights?
items.answer: Warranty coverage varies by product line and project requirements. Contact us for the latest documentation and support details.

items.question: Do you provide lighting layout support?
items.answer: Yes. We can help with facility planning, fixture selection, layout strategy, and lighting recommendations.
